summary_1line: Swetaki completes his sacrifice with Durvasa’s help; Agni, sick from excess ghee, is advised by Brahma to burn Khandava with aid from Krishna and Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Agni, pale and weakened from drinking endless ghee, bows before Brahma on his radiant seat seeking a cure.
The forest of Khandava erupts in flames as Agni and Vayu ignite it while elephants and serpents rush to douse the fire with torrents of water.
Brahma tells Agni that Nara and Narayana now walk the earth as Arjuna and Krishna, urging him to seek their help in burning Khandava.
